name: OrcaReplay Starter Kit
description_md:
Check what your coding agent did before accepting its completion claim.

Repository: The official OrcaReplay source link. First prompt: Try the included recording in a disposable project. Second prompt: Compare a claimed fix with recorded evidence and fresh tests.

Free Markdown guide in a ZIP. Includes trace-handling notes. Documentation inspected; prompts have not been tested end to end. New model calls may cost extra.
